title: 第10章 法尔霍庄第9章 金风野店
content_zh:
这一来，王怡丹和苏亦川再无怀疑，一起下拜。雷盖说：“杜老师，恕在下不能下床见礼。”杜静芳说：“好说。这位和王金童是怎生称呼？”说时眼望王怡丹。王怡丹说：“那是先父。”杜静芳说：“金童是我至交好友，想不到竟先我谢世。”言下不禁凄然。王怡丹眼眶一红，忍住了眼泪。杜静芳问苏亦川：“你是高师兄的徒弟？师兄近来可好？”苏亦川说：“托福，师父身子安健。他老人家常常惦记师姑，说有十多年不见啦，不知师姑在何处贵干，总是放心不下。”杜静芳怃然说：“我也很想念你师父。你可知另一个师叔也找你来了。”苏亦川矍然一惊，问道：“蔡……蔡锦昂师叔？”杜静芳点点头。雷盖听得蔡锦昂的名字，微微一震。王怡丹忙过去相扶，爱怜之情，见于颜色。
杜静芳说：“我这师弟自甘下流，真是我师门之耻。但他武功精纯，而且从维京过来，一定还有后援。现下雷主任身受重伤，我看眼前只有避他一避，然后我们再约好手，跟他一决雌雄。老婆子如不能为师门清除败类，这几根老骨头也就不打算再留下来啦。”话声虽低，却难掩心中愤慨之意。王怡丹说：“我们一切听杜姑姑吩咐。”说罢看了一下丈夫的脸色，雷盖点点头。
杜静芳从怀中掏出一封信来，交给王怡丹。王怡丹接过一看，封皮上写着：“敬烦面陈法尔霍庄郎天扬郎董”。王怡丹欢喜问：“您跟郎董有交情？”杜静芳还没回答，雷盖先问：“哪位郎董？”王怡丹说：“添皓集团董事长郎天扬！”雷盖又问：“法尔霍庄就在这里？”杜静芳说：“离此不过二三十里。我和郎董从没会过面，但神交已久，素知他肝胆照人，是个铁铮铮的好男子。我想请雷主任到他庄上去暂避一时，咱们分一个人去给朋友报信，来接雷主任去养伤。”她见雷盖脸色有点迟疑，便问：“雷主任你意思怎样？”
雷盖说：“杜老师这个安排本来再好不过。只是不瞒您说，在下身上担着血海的干系。**某位大佬不亲眼见到在下丧命，他是食不甘味，睡不安枕。郎董我们久仰大名，听说他是西北武林的领袖人物，交朋友再热心不过，那真是响当当的角色！他与我们虽然非亲非故，在下前去投奔，他碍于您的面子，那是非收留不可。然而这一收留，只怕后患无穷。他在此安家立业，万一给公家知道了，叫他受累，在下心中可万分不安。”
杜静芳说：“雷主任快别这么说。咱们江湖上讲的是‘义气’两字，为朋友两肋插刀，卖命尚且不惜，何况区区身家产业？咱们在这里遇到为难之事，不去找他，郎董将来要是知道了，反要怪咱们瞧他不起，眼中没他这**人物。”雷盖说：“在下这条命是甩出去了。鹰爪子再找来，我拼得一个是一个。杜老师您不知道，在下犯的事实在太大，越是好朋友，越是不能连累于他。”
杜静芳说：“我提一个人，你一定知道。太极门的王万户跟你怎样称呼？”雷盖说：“王主任？那也是我们的社员！”
杜静芳说：“对啦！你们协力社干的是什么事，我全不知情。可是万户贤弟跟我是过命的交情，当年我们在安国会出生入死，真比亲人还亲。他既是你们社员，那么你们的事一定正大光明，我是信得过的。你犯了大事却又怎么了？最大不过杀官造反。嘿嘿？刚才我就杀了两个走狗呐！”说着伸足在冯辉的尸体上踢了一脚。
雷盖说：“在下的事说来话长，过后只要留得一口气在，再详详细细禀告您。这次**派了八名高手来追捕我们夫妻。酒泉一战，在下身负重伤，亏得拙荆两把飞刀废了两个鹰爪子，好容易才逃到这里，哪知**又派出蔡锦昂跟着来啦。在下终是一死，但统万城里面的事情总要给他们抖出来才死得甘心。”
杜静芳琢磨这番话，似乎他获知了什么重大秘密，是以军事和司法机关接二连三派出高手要杀他灭口。他虽在大难之中，却不愿去连累别人，正是一人做事一人当的英雄本色，心想如不激上一激，他一定不肯投法尔霍庄去，便说：“雷主任，你不愿连累别人，那原是光明磊落的好汉子行径。只不过我想想有点可惜。”
雷盖忙问：“可惜什么？”杜静芳说：“你不愿去，我们三人能不能离开你？你身上有伤，动不得手，待会鹰爪子再来，我不是长他人志气，灭自己威风，只要有我师弟在内，咱们有谁是他敌手？这里一位是你夫人，一个是你盟弟，老妪虽然不才，也还知道朋友义气比自己性命要紧。咱们一落败，谁能弃你而逃？老妪这条命算是捡来的，陪你和他们拼了，并没什么可惜，可惜是我这个师侄方当有为，你这位夫人青春年少，只因你要逞英雄好汉，唉，累得全都丧命于此。”
雷盖听到这里，不由满头大汗，杜静芳的话虽然有点偏激，可全入情入理。王怡丹叫了声：“雷哥！”拿出手帕，把他额上汗珠拭去，握住他那只没受伤的手。雷盖二十五岁跟随耿伦浪荡江湖，掌下不知击毙过多少神奸巨憝、凶徒恶霸，但这双杀人无算的硬掌被王怡丹又温又软的手轻轻一握，正所谓“英雄气短，儿女情长”，再也不能坚执己见了，向杜静芳说：“杜老师教训的是，刚才是在下想岔了。您的指点，我唯命是从。”
杜静芳将写给郎天扬的信抽了出来。雷盖见信上先写了一些仰慕之言，再说有几位朋友遇到危难，请他照拂，信上没写众人的姓名。雷盖看后，叹了口气说：“我们这一到法尔霍庄，协力社又多了一位恩人了。”
杜静芳再问苏亦川该到何处去报信求援，后援何时可到。苏亦川说：“师姑，咱们协力社一共有十四名担当，老社长已经仙逝，除了小侄和雷哥、丹姊，其余社员都已会集伊吾。大家要请老社长的义子纪公子出山总领事务。纪公子一直不肯，说他年轻识浅，资历能力差得太远，非要菩真道长出任。道长又哪里肯？现下僵在那里，只等雷哥与丹姊一到，就开大会选举。谁知他们两位竟在这里被困。大家正眼巴巴在等他们呢。”
杜静芳欢喜说：“伊吾离此也不远，协力社好手大集。蔡锦昂武功再强，又怕他何来？”苏亦川向雷盖说：“纪公子派我去洛阳见乐天居士，分说一件误会，那也不是十万火急之事。小弟先赶回伊吾报信，雷哥你瞧怎么样？”雷盖沉吟未答。杜静芳说：“我瞧这样，你们三人马上动身去法尔霍庄，安顿好后，亦川就径赴洛阳。到伊吾报信的事就交给我去办。”
雷盖不再多说，彼此是成名豪杰，这样的事不必言谢，也非一声道谢所能报答，从怀中拿出一枚铁焰令，交给杜静芳说：“杜老师到了伊吾，请把这枚铁焰令别在衣襟上，社团自有人来接引。”王怡丹将雷盖扶起。苏亦川把地下两具尸体提到床上，用棉被蒙住。杜静芳打开门，大模大样走出来，上马向西疾驰而去。
过了片刻，苏亦川手执金笛开路，王怡丹一手撑了一根拖把，一手扶着雷盖走出房来。老板和服务员连日见他们恶战杀人，胆都寒了，站得远远的哪敢走近？苏亦川将三张支票抛在柜上，说道：“这是房饭钱！我们房里有两件贵重物事存着，谁也不许进去！少了东西回来跟你算账。”前台连声答应，大气也不敢出。服务员把三人的马牵来，双手不住发抖。雷盖两足不能踏镫，左手在马鞍上一按，一借力，轻轻飞身上马。苏亦川称赞：“好俊功夫！”王怡丹嫣然一笑，上马提缰，三骑连辔往东。
苏亦川问明了去法尔霍庄的途径，三人放马向东南方奔去，一口气走出十五六里，一问行人，知道过去不远就到。王怡丹暗暗欣慰，心知只要一到法尔霍庄，丈夫算是得救了。郎天扬威名远震，在西北两条路无人不敬，天大的事也担当得起，只消缓得一口气，大援便到，鹰爪子便来千军万马，也总有法子对付。
一路上乱石长草，颇为荒凉。忽听马蹄声急，迎面奔来三乘马。马上两个是精壮汉子，另一人身材甚是魁伟，白须如银，脸色红润，左手呛啷啷地弄着两个大铁胆。交错之际，三人向雷盖等看了一眼，脸现诧异之色，双方六骑马奔驰均疾，霎时间已相离十余丈。苏亦川说：“那位恐怕就是郎董了。”王怡丹说：“我也正想说。”雷盖说：“多半是他。但他走得这么快，怕有急事，半路上拦住了问名问姓，总是不妥。到法尔霍庄再说吧。”

At this point, Wang Yidan and Su Yichuan no longer had any doubts and bowed together. Lei Gai said: "Teacher Du, I'm sorry that I can't get out of bed to see you." Du Jingfang said: "It's easy to tell. How do you call this and Wang Jintong?" He looked at Wang Yidan while talking. Wang Yidan said: "That's my late father." Du Jingfang said: "The golden boy was my best friend, but I didn't expect that he would pass away before me." She couldn't help but feel sad. Wang Yidan's eyes turned red and she held back tears. Du Jingfang asked Su Yichuan: "Are you Senior Brother Gao's apprentice? How is Senior Brother doing recently?" Su Yichuan said: "Thank you, Master is in good health. He often misses Senior Sister and says he hasn't seen her for more than ten years. I don't know where Senior Sister is. Qian, I'm always worried." Du Jingfang said with regret, "I miss your master very much. Did you know that another uncle has also come to see you?" Su Yichuan was startled and asked: "Uncle Cai..." Du Jingfang nodded. Lei Gai was slightly shocked when he heard Cai Jinang's name. Wang Yidan hurriedly went over to help her, her love and compassion evident in her color.
Du Jingfang said: "This junior brother of mine is willing to commit suicide, which is really a disgrace to our school. But he is very good at martial arts, and he came from the Vikings, so he must have backup. Now that Director Lei is seriously injured, I can only avoid him, and then we can make an appointment to fight with him. If the old woman can't clean up the scum in the school, these old bones will not stay anymore." Although her voice was low, she couldn't hide the indignation in her heart. Wang Yidan said: "We all obey Aunt Du's orders." After saying that, he looked at her husband's face and Lei Gai nodded.
Du Jingfang took out a letter from her arms and handed it to Wang Yidan. Wang Yidan took it and took a look. It read on the cover: "I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Mr. Chen Falhuo Zhuang Lang Tianyang." Wang Yidan happily asked: "Do you have any friendship with Mr. Lang?" Before Du Jingfang could answer, Lei Gai asked first: "Which Mr. Lang?" Wang Yidan said: "Chairman of Tianhao Group Lang Tianyang!" Lei Gai asked again: "Is Falho Village here?" Du Jingfang said: "It's only twenty or thirty miles away. Director Lang and I have never We have met each other, but we have known each other for a long time, and we know that he is a very brave and good man. I would like to ask Director Lei to go to his village for a while, and one of us will send a message to a friend to pick up Director Lei to recover from his injuries." She saw Lei Gai's face was a little hesitant, so she asked, "Director Lei, what do you think?"
Lei Gai said: "Teacher Du, this arrangement is the best. But to tell you the truth, I am responsible for a sea of ​​blood.** If a certain big boss doesn't see me die with his own eyes, he will not be able to eat well and sleep restlessly. Mr. Lang, we have admired his name for a long time. We heard that he is a leader in the northwest martial arts. It is so exciting to make friends. I'm sorry, he is such a famous character! Although he is not related to us, I have to accept him because of your face. However, I am afraid that there will be endless consequences for him to settle down here. If the public finds out about it, I will feel very uneasy. "
Du Jingfang said: "Director Lei, please don't say that. What we talk about in the world is 'loyalty'. We are willing to sacrifice our lives for our friends, not to mention our wealth. If we encounter difficulties here, if we don't go to him, Director Lang will be blamed if he finds out in the future." We look down upon him, and we don't see him as a real person." Lei Gai said, "I'm going to throw away my life. If I come back again, I'll fight for it. Teacher Du, you don't know that the crime I committed is too big. The more good friends you are, the less likely you are to implicate him."
Du Jingfang said: "Let me mention someone, you must know it. What do you call Wang Wanhu of Tai Chi Sect?" Lei Gai said: "Director Wang? That is also a member of our club!"
Du Jingfang said: "That's right! I don't know anything about what you are doing with the cooperative society. But Brother Wanhu and I are life-long friends. We were born and died in Anhui, and we are really closer than relatives. Since he is a member of your society, then your affairs must be upright., I can trust it. You committed a serious crime but what happened? The biggest thing is to kill an official and rebel. hey-hey? I just killed two lackeys! "As he spoke, he stretched out his foot and kicked Feng Hui's body.
Lei Gai said: "What happened next is a long story. I will tell you in detail as long as I have some time to breathe. This time the police sent eight masters to hunt down our couple. During the battle in Jiuquan, I was seriously injured. Fortunately, Zhuo Jing used two flying knives to destroy two eagle talons. I finally managed to escape here, but I didn't expect that the government sent Cai Jinang to follow him. I will eventually die, but the things in Tongwan City must be revealed to them before I can be willing to die. "
Du Jingfang thought about these words, and it seemed that he had learned some important secret, so the military and judicial agencies sent out experts one after another to kill him and silence him. Although he was in a great crisis, he did not want to harm others, which is exactly what he is like as a hero. He thought that if he did not get a little provocation, he would definitely not be willing to go to Falkho Village, so he said: "Director Lei, you don't want to harm others. That is the behavior of a good and aboveboard man. It's just a pity when I think about it. "
Lei Gai asked quickly: "What's the pity? Du Jingfang said: "If you don't want to go, can the three of us leave you?" You are injured and cannot move. The eagle's talons will come back later. I am not trying to embolden others' ambitions and destroy my own prestige. As long as my junior brother is included, who among us can be his opponent? One here is your wife, and the other is your ally. Although the old woman is not talented, she still knows that the loyalty of her friends is more important than her own life. Once we lose, who can abandon you and run away? The old woman was lucky enough to have this life. I fought with them with you, so there is no regret in it. But it is a pity that I, my nephew, should be the one to make a difference, and you, my wife, are young and young. Just because you want to be a hero, alas, you all died because of exhaustion. "
Lei Gai couldn't help but sweat profusely when he heard this. Although Du Jingfang's words were a bit extreme, they were completely reasonable. Wang Yidan shouted: "Brother Lei! "Take out a handkerchief, wipe the sweat off his forehead, and hold his uninjured hand. Lei Gai followed Geng Lun around the world when he was twenty-five years old. He killed countless traitors, villains, and thugs under his hands, but these two hands were useless. His hard palm was gently grasped by Wang Yidan's warm and soft hand. As the saying goes, "Heroes are short-tempered, but children's love is long-lasting." He could no longer stick to his own opinion and said to Du Jingfang: "Teacher Du taught me that I was thinking wrong just now. I will obey your instructions. "
Du Jingfang took out the letter written to Lang Tianyang. When Lei Gai saw the letter, he first wrote some words of admiration, and then said that several friends were in danger and asked him to take care of them. No names were written on the letter. After looking at it, Lei Gai sighed and said: "When we arrived at Falho Village, the Cooperative Society had another benefactor. "
Du Jingfang asked Su Yichuan where to report for help and when the support would arrive. Su Yichuan said: "Sister, our cooperative has a total of fourteen directors. The old president has passed away. Except for my nephew, Brother Lei and Sister Dan, all the other members have gathered in Yiwu. We want to invite Mr. Ji, the adopted son of the old president, to take over the affairs. Mr. Ji has always refused, saying that he is young and has little knowledge, and his qualifications and abilities are too far behind. He insists on having Taoist Master Bo Zhen take up the post. How could the Taoist be willing? Now they are stuck there, just waiting for Brother Lei and Sister Dan to arrive and hold a general meeting for elections. Unexpectedly, the two of them were trapped here. Everyone is eagerly waiting for them. "
Du Jingfang said happily: "Iwu is not far from here, and there are a lot of good people in the Xieli Society. No matter how powerful Cai Jinang is in martial arts, why should he be afraid of him? Su Yichuan said to Lei Gai: "Master Ji sent me to Luoyang to meet with Loyalty Master Loyalty to explain a misunderstanding. That is not an urgent matter." My younger brother rushed back to Yiwu to report the news. Brother Lei, what do you think? Lei Gai pondered and did not answer. Du Jingfang said: "I see, the three of you will leave for Falhuo Village immediately. After settling in, Yichuan will go to Luoyang." Leave it to me to report the news to Yiwu. "
Lei Gai said no more. We are famous heroes, soThere was no need to say thank you, nor could I repay him with just a single thank you. He took out an Iron Flame Token from his arms, handed it to Du Jingfang and said, "When Mr. Du arrives in Yiwu, please pin this Iron Flame Token on your lapel, and someone from the club will come to pick him up." Wang Yidan helped Lei Gai up. Su Yichuan lifted the two corpses from the ground to the bed and covered them with quilts. Du Jingfang opened the door, walked out grandly, mounted her horse and galloped westward.
After a while, Su Yichuan opened the way with a golden flute in his hand, and Wang Yidan held a mop with one hand and supported Lei Gai with the other as he walked out of the room. The boss and waiters were frightened to see them fighting and killing people for days. How dare they stand so far away and get closer? Su Yichuan threw the three checks on the counter and said, "This is room money! We have two valuables stored in the room. No one is allowed to go in! If there are any missing items, I will come back to settle the account with you." The front desk promised repeatedly without daring to express his anger. The waiter brought the horses of the three of them, his hands trembling. Lei Gai couldn't put his feet in the stirrups. He pressed his left hand on the saddle and used his strength to lightly fly onto the horse. Su Yichuan praised: "What a handsome kung fu!" Wang Yidan smiled brightly, mounted his horse, picked up the reins, and rode three horses to the east.
Su Yichuan asked about the way to Farho Village, and the three of them galloped toward the southeast, covering fifteen or six miles in one go. After asking the passers-by, they found out that they were not far away. Wang Yidan was secretly relieved, knowing that as soon as she arrived at Falho Village, her husband would be saved. Lang Tianyang's reputation was far-reaching, no one disrespected him on the two roads in the northwest, and he could take on big things. As long as he took a breath, help would arrive, and thousands of troops would come with eagle talons, and there would always be a way to deal with it.
There were rocks and grass along the way, making it quite desolate. Suddenly, I heard the rapid sound of horse hooves, and three horses came running towards me. Two of them are strong men. The other one is very tall, with a white beard as white as silver and a rosy face. He is holding two big iron gallbladders with his left hand. When they were crossing each other, the three of them glanced at Lei Gai and the others, with a look of surprise on their faces. The six horses on both sides were galloping very fast, and in an instant they were more than ten feet apart. Su Yichuan said, "I'm afraid that's Mr. Lang." Wang Yidan said, "I was about to say that too." Lei Gai said, "It's probably him. But he was walking so fast, and for fear of something urgent, it's always inappropriate to stop him and ask his name and surname on the way. Let's talk about it at Farho Village."
